title: [Extensibility Request] issue 29074: expose PurchLineQty in OnSumPurchLines2OnBeforeDivideAmount
summary: The OnSumPurchLines2OnBeforeDivideAmount event now exposes the PurchLineQty parameter by reference, allowing subscribers to adjust the purchase line quantity before amount division calculations run.
key_points: Added a var PurchLineQty: Decimal parameter at the end of OnSumPurchLines2OnBeforeDivideAmount
Subscribers can change the quantity used before DivideAmount runs in SumPurchLines2
Applied to W1 and every country layer with its own Purch.-Post copy (APAC, BE, CH, ES, FI, GB, IT, NA, RU)
Requested to support amount-only purchasing modes in partner solutions
